title: Gospel Conformity
summary: Paul calls the church in Corinth to examine whether they are in the faith, and to be conformed to the gospel by grace.

key_points.heading: Examine yourselves
key_points.body: Paul tells the church to examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith.

key_points.heading: Conformed by grace
key_points.body: We are conformed to the gospel of Jesus Christ by his grace and not by our strength.

closing_takeaway: May we be conformed to the gospel of Jesus Christ.
excerpt: Paul calls the church to examine whether they are in the faith.
